description: Call log: one file per session under .harness/runtime/logs/<surface>/. Tool arguments are never recorded; a call that was denied or sent to a person keeps its paths and command (cut to max_text_chars). capture saves the raw hook input and output of every call, for finding out what a runtime sends: leave it off, the input holds code. knowledge_base_reads: keep the names of the knowledge base files a call read (never their content), so `kb reads` can say which files nobody reads.
